scene: The neon claw cabinet lights up, rattling over a heap of prizes.
picture: First-person close-up view through the cabinet glass. Suspended up high hangs a three-pronged metal claw above colourful robotic hamster plushies. On the lower left console sits a bright red joystick. On the right console glows a large round yellow button. The dark rectangular prize chute flap rests below on the far right.
shown: a blinking red joystick sticking out on the lower left console
a massive flashing circular button glowing yellow on the right console
a dark flap on the far right bottom corner waiting empty
